name: My Neighbour Next Door
source:
Welcome to your new apartment—and your new life! In "My Neighbour Next Door," you’ve just moved in, and things are about to get interesting as you meet five wildly different (and very attractive) neighbors. Will you be drawn to the tough guy with a soft spot, the charming actor next door, the fun-loving tradie, the grumpy nerd, or the shy loner? It’s up to you! Your choices will shape your story as you get closer to each neighbor, discover their secrets, and maybe even find love right next door.

Moving in has never been this exciting!

[From [url=https://lifecrises.itch.io/my-neighbour-next-door]Itch.io[/url]]
